demos.name: Secrets Vault LAB
demos.description: A per-user credential vault (self-service, no administrator override, real AES-256-GCM, injected by a simulated gateway) and secret store management over five mock providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, Delinea, CyberArk). Mock or Live mode. Every product claim is UNVERIFIED on our tenant.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7450). Docker: HOST_PORT=7450 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock and Live are both loopback-only with zero outbound calls; every credential is a lab-labelled mock and no API ever returns a stored value.
